notes.notes:

notes.title: News #10
notes.notes:
Greetings to all who are not indifferent!

  April and early May were very intense for us in terms of game development and health. 
  In spite of everything, we tried to do everything that we had in mind by the stated date, but as we moved towards the release, a number of technical and logical problems arose that did not fit into the existing time frame. We can't release the game as it is now, so we have to move the release date. 
  We need approximately 2 more months. We will be able to announce a more precise date when some of the technical problems will be solved. 

We hope for your understanding and wish you all good health!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39974681/3eb9d19b0e153b3b5c5ac1cce92ef40a192c90e3.gif[/img]
